common_clauses.title: Parties to Agreement
common_clauses.template: This Rental Agreement is executed between {{landlord_name}} (hereinafter referred to as the 'Landlord') and {{tenant_name}} (hereinafter referred to as the 'Tenant').

common_clauses.title: Property Description
common_clauses.template: The Landlord agrees to let out the property situated at {{property_address}} to the Tenant for residential purposes.

common_clauses.title: Monthly Rent
common_clauses.template: The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of INR {{monthly_rent}} on or before the {{rent_due_date}} day of each month.

common_clauses.title: Security Deposit
common_clauses.template: The Tenant has paid INR {{security_deposit}} as refundable security deposit to the Landlord.

common_clauses.title: Lease Duration
common_clauses.template: The tenancy shall commence from {{lease_start_date}} and continue until {{lease_end_date}}.

common_clauses.title: Lock-in Period
common_clauses.template: Neither party shall terminate this agreement during the lock-in period of {{lock_in_period_months}} months.

common_clauses.title: Maintenance Charges
common_clauses.template: Maintenance charges shall be borne by {{maintenance_paid_by}}.

common_clauses.title: Utilities
common_clauses.template: Electricity, water, gas, internet, and utility charges shall be paid by {{utility_paid_by}}.

common_clauses.title: Late Payment
common_clauses.template: In case of delay in rent payment, a late fee of INR {{late_fee_amount}} may be charged.

common_clauses.title: Notice Period
common_clauses.template: Either party may terminate this agreement by providing {{notice_period_days}} days prior written notice.

common_clauses.title: Inspection Rights
common_clauses.template: The Landlord may inspect the premises upon prior notice to the Tenant.

common_clauses.title: Damages
common_clauses.template: The Tenant shall be liable for damages caused beyond normal wear and tear.

common_clauses.title: Pets
common_clauses.template: Keeping pets inside the premises is {{pets_allowed}}.

common_clauses.title: Illegal Activities
common_clauses.template: The Tenant shall not engage in any illegal or unlawful activities on the premises.

common_clauses.title: Governing Law
common_clauses.template: This agreement shall be governed by the laws applicable in the State of execution.

DL.title: Delhi Stamp Duty Compliance
DL.template: This agreement shall be stamped in accordance with the applicable provisions of Delhi stamp laws.

DL.title: Delhi Registration
DL.template: If the tenancy exceeds 11 months, the agreement may require registration under applicable law.

MH.title: Leave and License Nature
MH.template: This agreement is executed as a Leave and License Agreement under applicable Maharashtra laws.

MH.title: Police Verification
MH.template: The Tenant shall cooperate with police verification formalities as required in Maharashtra.

MH.title: e-Registration
MH.template: The parties agree to complete e-registration and biometric authentication if applicable.

KA.title: Kaveri Registration
KA.template: The parties may register this agreement using the Kaveri online registration platform.

KA.title: Standard Notice
KA.template: A standard notice period shall apply unless otherwise mutually agreed.

TS.title: Telangana e-Stamp
TS.template: The agreement may be executed using Telangana approved e-stamp mechanisms.

TS.title: Police Verification
TS.template: Tenant police verification may be conducted if required by local authorities.

UP.title: UP Tenancy Compliance
UP.template: The parties agree to comply with the Uttar Pradesh tenancy regulations applicable to urban premises.

UP.title: Registration Compliance
UP.template: Registration may be mandatory depending upon the lease duration under applicable Uttar Pradesh laws.

HR.title: Haryana e-Stamp
HR.template: This agreement may be executed using Haryana approved e-stamping facilities.

HR.title: Jurisdiction
HR.template: Courts located within Haryana shall have jurisdiction over disputes arising from this agreement.
